evidence.snippet: To fill the gaps, we introduce EHRBench, an automated and reliable EHR-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLM-based clinical decision-making at scale.

claire_radar.motivation: Clinical decision-making (CDM) is central to real-world clinical workflows, where clinicians infer diagnoses, select treatments, or anticipate future health outcomes under incomplete evidence.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing clinical decision benchmarks often lack scale and reliability; EHRBench provides a large-scale, EHR-grounded evaluation that tests models on practical inference tasks, offering insights into model capabilities and gaps for clinical deployment.
